def main()
mut h: Hash<Integer, Integer> := {}
mut i := 0
while i < 1000
h[i] = i
i += 1
end
puts(h.size())
puts(h[999])
while i > 0
i -= 1
h.delete(i)
end
puts(h.size())
end
